claims.claim: Ai Pin is the first wearable device and software platform built to harness the full power of AI
Laser Ink Display projects a usable interface onto the user's palm
Ai Mic and Cosmos/Ai Bus remove apps entirely; AI routes every request fast and reliably
Perpetual power system with hot-swappable battery boosters gives all-day battery life
Available to order in the US from November 16, starting at $699 for the complete system
$699 device plus $24 per month subscription with unlimited talk, text and data

delta: Screenless wearable: voice, touchpad and gesture instead of a screen
Laser projector as the display, projecting onto the palm instead of any screen
Standalone cellular device on Humane's own MVNO - no phone required

prior_art.differs: AI wearable with camera, voice assistant (Meta AI) and open-ear audio - announced Sep 27, 2023 and in stores Oct 17 at $299, six weeks before the Pin; differs in form (glasses, phone-paired, no laser display) and in that it actually shipped to reviewers
prior_art.name: Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses

prior_art.differs: Established wrist wearable with voice assistant, apps and cellular; the Pin's bet is that removing the screen and the apps is an improvement - unproven
prior_art.name: Apple Watch

recheck_when: When independent hands-on reviews land (first units ship early 2024)
tldr: A $699 screenless wearable that promises to replace your phone with an AI assistant and a laser display on your palm - nobody outside Humane has used one, orders open next week, and it doesn't ship until next year.
